atomicity.reason: One obligation: a lane detection algorithm. 'Process camera input' and 'identify lane markings' are facets of the same detection pipeline, not independent requirements.

comprehensibility.reason: Self-contained and intelligible on its own without reading adjacent requirements.

feasibility.reason: Camera-based lane detection is implementable with known technology and contradicts nothing else stated.

parent_fit.reason: NEED_001 requires detecting lane markings and steering; this requirement substantively addresses the lane-marking-detection half of that obligation.

unambiguity.reason: Core meaning is clear, but 'various lighting conditions' is an underspecified term open to interpretation on which conditions are in scope.
unambiguity.suggestion: Replace 'various lighting conditions' with an explicit enumerated list.

verifiability.reason: Directionally testable, but 'accurately' has no defined accuracy threshold and 'various lighting conditions' names no concrete set of conditions to test against.
verifiability.suggestion: State a detection accuracy target (e.g. >=95% true-positive rate) and enumerate the lighting conditions (day, night, dusk, glare) to validate.

summary: Substantively covers the lane-detection arm of NEED_001; single detection obligation, but 'accurately'/'various lighting conditions' leave the success condition unquantified.
